Rob Yule
Robin John Yule is a New Zealand rugby union coach. In September 2006, Yule, the Program Development Manager of New Zealand's Taranaki Rugby Football Union, was in Sri Lanka as a special observer for Singer Sri Lankan International Rugby Sevens in Kandy. Having joined Taranaki rugby in March, 1996, Yule has contributed immensely towards the province's success in New Zealand Rugby.
